verdict.rationale: Fern's first-party docs say versions add a reader-facing dropdown selector for multiple releases. Each version can carry its own tabs, sections, pages and API references, and versions can share content, which covers both per-version publishing and site-side switching. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of versioning, and documentation detail on per-product (versus per-release) versioning and version URL/default behavior.
